standard_prerequisites.name: Etale permanence for algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that a morphism between algebraic spaces both representable and etale over U is etale.

core_obligations: Represent the two fibre products X x_Z U and Y x_Z U by algebraic spaces etale over U, using the assumptions on X -> Z and Y -> Z.
Apply etale permanence to the induced morphism between them, then re-express X x_Y U as a fibre product over Y x_Z U to conclude X x_Y U -> U is etale.
proof_roadmap: Represent both 2-fibre products over U, transfer etaleness between the representing spaces by the permanence lemma, and finish with the displayed fibre-product identity X x_Y U = (X x_Z U) x_{(Y x_Z U)} U.
difficulty_reason: Two-step rearrangement of fibre products with a single named permanence lemma; no construction.
